info.name: Tsukasa Tenma
info.sexuality: "Pansexual" (actually homosexual because Rui was his gay awakening)
info.housing: Southern Glen, Block #3, 307 w/ Rui Kamishiro
info.guilds: Children of the Stars, Search and Rescue, and Lorekeepers
info.jobs: Actor @ Solaria Opera House, Part-time worker @ Last Stitches
info.goals: To stay with Rui until the curtain call.
info.personality:
Tsukasa has a rather energetic and bright personality that people at first glance might call obnoxiously loud and strange. He has a habit of showing off to express himself that often gives secondhand embarrassment to others like his sister. He can be a little egocentric, when he gets too absorbed in his goal of becoming a star, but his friends helped him realize how much he loves performing and through performances, his charisma and radiance truly shines.

The intensity of his personality comes from his strong passion for acting, desiring to grow much more as an actor through each show and role he performs. Though Tsukasa can be a little silly at times, he is a reliable and diligent person who studies the character given to him deeply and practices his role until he feels satisfied. However, he has a tendency to overwork himself when his vision becomes too narrow and he gets obsessed with trying to achieve a certain result. When issues like that come for him, he will remain open-minded and take any advice others give him to apply to his acting, helping him achieve breakthroughs.

He has exceptional faith in his troupe members and believes in them, despite some initial misgivings he may have. The bond he has with them serves a reminder to him about his feelings to make people happy by putting on a fantastic show.
trivia: He spent all the money he had on him upon coming to Solasta, to buy a piano that barely fits in his apartment because it feels wrong to him not to have one.
He spent all the money he had on him upon coming to Solasta, to buy a piano that barely fits in his apartment because it feels wrong to him not to have one.

Adopted a male Sun Conure for a pet and his name is Crimson Starlet Phoenix Tenma (Crimson Phenny for short) and a male Green-Cheeked Conure with a violet color mutation named Rainbow Miracle Wonder Kamishiro
Sparring with Ithaqua often for training
He's very good with all manners of managing the household now
Wears a matching choker with his significant other

plotting.preferred_areas: Can be found almost anywhere but his current favorite go-to places are: Fortuna Association, Last Stitches, Dynamic Designs, Imaginarium Theatre, Solasta Opera House, Blue Ridge Mall, Moonlight Borough
plotting.interaction_notes: Tsukasa has the energy between an Abyssinian cat and a Shiba Inu, so please be mindful he's extremely social and loud and maybe overdramatic at times! He's a bit of a busybody so he tends to reach out to people. (And honestly I would love to put him more out there.)
plotting.shipping: Tsukasa is closed for shipping. He is completely devoted to his director and moon, Rui Kamishiro.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Tsukasa is 18. Can partake in discussion of topics but exclusive to partner only.
plotting_hooks: Meeting Tsukasa at Last Stitches, his other part-time job. He can repair any tears and strike up a conversation about fashion.
Mall. He’s always looking for new places to explore so he can go with his partner or friend in the future.
Training. (He’s a Guardian/Navigator). He is very dedicated to keeping his body in shape and keeping up with classes.
Tokusatsu club. Heroes greatly interest him and he also likes learning about the production process behind a hero show.
Piano! Sometimes, Tsukasa may ask the owner if he could play on it for a bit. He will happily talk about the piano.
Plushies! He can be found in shops that sell plushies or make them.
Street performance! He and Rui have a habit of performing guerilla shows. He will happily talk about shows.
Opera House! He's working on several scripts of his own. Again, he will happily talk about shows and probably also have a deeper conversation about production.
Paws Rising. He recently got another pet bird so he's always looking for advice on how to raise his birb sons.
Reaching out to him indirectly by Rui or other friends
Reaching out to him for romantic advice whether it's him asking or asking him. (I promise he gives solid advice most of the time…)
Talking about siblings with him. He really misses his siblings!!

info.name: Caelus
info.goals: To return back to the Astral Express(?)
info.personality:
At first glance, Caelus seems like a calm and collected individual. In most situations and combat, he can be a rational thinker and is not afraid to take charge. He is also capable of negotiating in order to win a debate. Unfortunately, when he is presented with set choices he needs to make, he tends to make the bolder and riskier choices... which half the time is resolved by combat.

Underneath his calm exterior, Caelus embodies the spirit of the Trailblaze, having the explorer’s heart to interact with everything… trash cans included. He also tries to reap rewards any time he can, even if he appears to look shameless. Some of these interactions are quite questionable that his allies can be quite exasperated with him. He also has the penchant to make bad jokes and whenever the opportunity arises, he will flex himself. Nevertheless, he is quite social and likes holding conversations with his friends, going over various topics or trends that mutually share his interests. He looks out for his allies and gives his moral support whenever they need it.

And most importantly, he will absolutely never back down from a challenge, as serious or even silly as it can be. To be a Trailblazer, is to forge ahead undaunted.
trivia: He has two pets; a miniature pig named Ivory Menace and a giant Flemish rabbit named Pom-Pom Jr. One has a destructive personality with their cuteness, the other is a refined scholar who will silently judge Caelus if he touches the TV remote
Everyone is telling him to train Ivory Menace and regain control of his household, but unfortunately there’s dwindling hope that will happen
Sleeps in a cardboard box most of the time. Mostly because Ivory Menace took the bed and Pom-Pom Jr took the couch.
While he’s been able to suppress it deep down since his first trial, recent events has made his nihilism creep up a tiny bit again

plotting.preferred_areas: Anywhere, especially areas with trash, but his current favorite go-to places are: Bathaus
plotting.interaction_notes: Caelus is a bit of a wildcard. He can have a decent conversation, but likes teasing and ragebaiting (sometimes it's unintentional even) if the opportunity arises. But he has no mean-spirited intentions and is very open to debates and philosophical conversations.
plotting.shipping: Available, but due to his sexuality, it takes a while for him to form an emotional bond before proceeding to romance
plotting.nsfw: ❓ - Limited. Caelus is 18+ so he's fine with the discussion of topics. However, he's not comfortable imagining himself in situations, so this may take him a bit even with a romantic partner.
plotting_hooks: Trash. Unfortunately, he's an actual raccoon and you'll often find him scavenging the trash with his trash can cat.
Pets. He adores his giant Flemish rabbit Pom-Pom Jr and miniature pig Ivory Menace so much even if he’s on the bottom of the pecking order. He finds his trash cake cat Astral a menace though.
Training. He is always down for sparring and may show off his other path skills.
Gaming. Same with training, he's always down for a good gaming session locally or online, whether it's PvP or Co-op. He also likes classical board games too.
Bats. Oh glorious bats. Of course, the Galactic Baseballer has fashioned himself as a connoisseur to them, so he will always be down to talk about them.
Selfies. Caelus is but a vain creature who likes taking images at the most opportune and inopportune time. Want to take a shot with him?
Astral Express. He's always down to talk about his journeys and the cool and stupid things he’s done.
Cartoons. He really likes classical cartoons like Clockie and Hanu. Always up for chatting about it.
Automobiles. Want a ride on the Trashinator?

info.name: Natsume Sakasaki
info.housing: Rose Point, Townhouse #1 w/ Mao Isara
info.personality:
Natsume is a tricky boy who relies on his wits and intelligence to adapt to various situations. He usually works behind the scenes to tactfully gain benefits for himself and his unit. He can also be quite petty and those who mock or wrong him will earn a grudge for a long time.

While he is called a genius and acts like one, in actuality, he works very hard and desperately to catch up to those he admires, the other four Eccentrics. However, time and time again, he feels he’s still inferior to them and wishes to overcome his weakness, especially after they sacrificed their reputations to protect him. Due to this, he can lose his way when his heart wavers and place burdens on his own heart.

Natsume can act quite mysterious and at times quite capricious, but it’s really to hide his true feelings. This is especially the case for when he’s being kind but refuses to say so until someone points it out. Nevertheless, Natsume is very empathetic and has a desire to protect the weaker and the outcasts, being in the same position once. To that end, he will cling to his ideals of being a magician to write the pages of a new story for his audience. Isn’t that what happy endings are for?
trivia: Growing a small indoor garden, still debating if he needs to move it outdoors anywhere
Has recently adopted two kittens named Apollo and Artemis

plotting.preferred_areas: His current favorite go-to places are: Haunted Oddities, Blue Ridge Mall, Moonlight Borough, Catpuccino, Wrench & Win, Australe Observatory
plotting.interaction_notes: Natsume is pretty careful in his interactions, which often paints him a bit shady, but he means well. Sometimes he can be more earnest depending on the situation. Do note, he does have a really sharp tongue if upset.
plotting.nsfw: ✅ - Natsume is 18+. Can partake in discussion of topics but exclusive to partner only.
plotting_hooks: Fortune telling. He's always up for reading people’s fortunes and will give some decent advice. Typically, he can be found in the Bazaar for that on the occasion he opens shop.
Magic. He loves performing magic to people on a whim. You might catch him doing tricks on his own sometime.
Training. Sometimes he can be found training at the Training Hall.
Finding him on his job. He can be interacted with while working, whether you’re his coworker or customer.

Finding him in the middle of his experiments. Sometimes, he'll be conducting outdoor experiments if he's not closed up in his room. His experiments are generally safe, because he would rather not get in trouble. His experiments aren't limited to chemical reactions, as he likes to tinker with broken things to fix them too.
Rare, wild Pokemon encounter at the Solasta Education Center. Specifically to use the science labs and trying to procure some chemicals and materials.
Gaming or entertainment facilities. He's a gamer himself so places like Skill Points and Cipher34 highly interest him. He’s also online a lot in the Gamer's club.
Gardening. It’s one of his hobbies so he'll be in places related to that, like the Moonlight Borough.
Cats. He loves cats. He has two cats: Artemis and Apollo and he can be found sometimes at Catpuccino.
Idols. It's a bit of a sore topic for him because he’s missing Switch, but he will gladly give idol-related advice or talk about his experience.
Staging. He was in charge of Switch's production and was a part of the theatrical troupe Dramatica, so he has much knowledge in regards to that.

info.name: Howan
info.housing: Lilac Lane, Block #1 w/ Kiana Kaslana
info.jobs: Server @ Blue Ridge Mall Food Court, Helper @ Hazelnut Fields
info.personality:
Howan is a sweet, optimistic girl who is also quite adventurous. Her upbringing in the countryside raised her to be a diligent and hardworking person, as well knowing to be grateful to the bountiful harvests and her community. Stories and interactions with her grandmother gave her a bold and curious nature, which sparked her dream to go to Midi City. She loves music and treasures her guitar and friends dearly. However, she does not come without her flaws.

She is quite gullible with her naïveté of the city, where once she almost had herself legally bound to a contract forever. She is also quite clumsy in new environments and need to take a bit of time to learn to adjust herself. Her time management can be a little disorganized when it comes to part-time jobs.

Howan can also be very oblivious, not realizing her friend's feelings until later. However, she is open to communication and will seek out to address their problems, making her very easy to talk to. Her innocent heart and desire to reach out to others wins out people's hearts.

And most importantly, her greatest strength is not giving up her dream and doing what she loves to do: performing music!
trivia: Named the Will-o-wisps Rui gave her during the expedition ‘Mashima’ and ‘Himeko’
Likes practicing her guitar outside at Moonlight Borough when it’s sunny
Designated Masamune and Michinaga as Cool Big Bro #1 and Cool Big Bro #2
Cherishes her friendship with Night Watch

plotting.preferred_areas: Anywhere, especially music-oriented, but her current favorite go-to places are: Imaginarium Theatre, Moonlight Borough
plotting.interaction_notes: Very social and happy to interact with others!! She is an Artic Fox Myumon, so her mannerisms come off quite affectionate and playful. She's a bit slow to understand things, but everything she says comes from the heart and she easily trusts people.
plotting.shipping: Unavailable, Howan is heavily implied to be dating Mashima Himeko at her canon point, therefore she is closed to relationships.
plotting.nsfw: ❌ - Howan is listed 18, but I strongly feel she doesn't have the maturity to partake in these topics.
plotting_hooks: Music!! You can find her in places anywhere related to music or her performing a street live. She will happily talk about songs, composing, and her band.
Guitar/Instruments. Similarly, you can find her in places related to music, but she has knowledge about the guitar especially, though her way of talking about them is less on the technical side…
Training. She’s been steadily practicing with her new weapon since she ranked up, and she will appreciate help on that.
City. Howan’s from the countryside but she loves exploring new places in the big city and will happily ask for guidance.
Classes. She’s a Nurse/Forager. She will happily help out and give advice as a nurse, but she would love to receive advice back as well as on her Forager subclass.
Farming. She grew up in a farming village, so she loves to volunteer helping out at Hazelnut Fields.
Homeland. Curious about her fox ears and tail? She would be glad to talk in detail about Midi City and its citizens
Cooking. She loves cooking and is always on the search for new recipes, especially trendy ones in the city!
Housework. Like cooking, Howan is extremely comfortable with housework and can offer to help out!

relationships.name: Ithaqua
relationships.description: A cherished friend, who always looks after her. He may think he's a monster, but she sees under his mask for who he is.
